niche.habitat: Hydrothermal ridge zones and tidal flat interfaces
niche.diet: Chemosynthetic mat biomass and piezo-electric strain energy
niche.active: Tidal-cycle burst; eclipse dormancy or mating

body: Low-slung carapace with hinged thermal vents and capacitor-joints; six limb-arms for anchoring and filtering; heat-pit sensory array along flanks.

chains.trait: Capacitor-limbs crackle and assist movement during tidal flex
links: Organic piezoelectric crystals in joint matrix store charge
Mechanical stress releases stored ATP and kinetic assist

skill.effect: Converts environmental tidal stress into a burst of movement speed (150%) and a shock attack dealing 12 damage; drains charge over 5 turns.

chains.weakness: Discharges quickly in calm water or during thermal tides; immobile without stored strain.
observe: Skin glows faint blue at joints before movement.
Hunts exclusively near spreading ridges with active flex.
Joints emit micro-sparks when the giant's gravity peaks.

journal.en: It stores the moon's heartbeat in its bones, bursting forward when the tides scream.

plausibility.summary: Reframe joints as strain-gated elastic recoil (spring tendons primed by tidal flex) plus weak piezo triggers for timing; drop ‘ATP from charge’ and optional piezo crystals as sensory, not primary motor fuel. Remove ‘piezo-electric strain energy’ from diet—it is not a food.
fixes: Reframe joints as strain-gated elastic recoil (spring tendons primed by tidal flex) plus weak piezo triggers for timing; drop ‘ATP from charge’ and optional piezo crystals as sensory, not primary motor fuel. Remove ‘piezo-electric strain energy’ from diet—it is not a food.

analogues.organism: Teleost lateral line and shark ampullae of Lorenzini detect strain and weak EM fields; tendon–muscle elastic storage in kangaroos and fleas releases stored mechanical work—not piezoelectric capacitors.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Veins flush carotenoid-symbionts during stellar flare events
links: Radical scavenging prevents DNA breaks and fuels repair

skill.effect: Reduces radiation damage by 80% and heals 2 HP per turn during flare events; symbionts shed 5% max HP in clean water.

chains.weakness: Symbionts die in low-radiation zones; shedding leaves it vulnerable to infection.
observe: Flushing red along vascular ridges before M-class flare alerts.
Avoids open equator during peak radiation hours.
Sheds glittering carotenoid scales in safe magnetic valleys.

journal.en: A walking shield that eats the storm and glows with borrowed grace.

plausibility.summary: Keep symbionts in epidermal or gut microbe layers rather than vascular ‘veins’; scale passive mitigation to partial ROS/DNA repair benefit, not near-immunity.
fixes: Keep symbionts in epidermal or gut microbe layers rather than vascular ‘veins’; scale passive mitigation to partial ROS/DNA repair benefit, not near-immunity.

chains.trait: Carapace splits open during eclipse umbra to vent heat
links: Rapid thermal contraction during 40-minute total eclipse
Shell stress exceeds fracture threshold of hinge joints
Fissures open to release superheated steam and mating pheromones

skill.effect: At eclipse onset, splits shell to heal 20 HP, release pheromones (befriend all grazers within 50m), and gain 'Heat Shield' (+5 Defence) but is Vulnerable to area attacks for 3 turns.

chains.weakness: Completely exposed and immobile during the bloom; cannot act until eclipse ends.
observe: Shells crack with audible pops exactly at shadow-line.
Steam vents erupt from dorsal fissures.
Herds gather and lock legs during the split phase.

journal.en: The world goes dark, and it opens its heart to the giant's shadow.

plausibility.summary: Eclipse bloom: hinge opens slightly for pheromone release and mate visibility in twilight, or seals carapace for insulation during chill; steam only after giant returns and rock reheats—or mate during umbra while motionless, with vulnerability window, not heat venting.
fixes: Eclipse bloom: hinge opens slightly for pheromone release and mate visibility in twilight, or seals carapace for insulation during chill; steam only after giant returns and rock reheats—or mate during umbra while motionless, with vulnerability window, not heat venting.

chains.trait: Ciliated ridges filter vent plumes for direct chemosynthetic absorption
links: Hydrothermal effluents rich in H2S and CH4
Ciliated filtration membranes trap chemolithotrophic biomass
Enzymatic breakdown provides direct carbon and energy

skill.effect: Target within 30m near a vent; absorbs 8 HP and applies 'Chem-Burn' (2 damage/turn) to target for 4 turns; heals Marevora for 30% of damage dealt.

chains.weakness: Blind to visual cues; ineffective far from vent plumes.
observe: Drifts suspended near black smoker plumes.
No external eyes; heat-pit pits line the mouth.

journal.en: It reads the world through steam, tasting life where fire meets water.

body_plan.origin: Benthic radiation shelter and vent colonization

temperament: Docile grazer unless discharged or eclipsed; defensive piezo-shock on contact.
secrets: Squeezing the capacitor-joints during combat releases a stored EMP burst that stuns mechanical constructs for 2 turns.
The carotenoid shedding can be harvested to craft temporary radiation-resistant poultices.
The heat-pit array can detect underground magma flows, revealing safe paths through volcanic rifts.
moments: During the 40-minute eclipse, the entire herd locks legs and splits their carapaces simultaneously, releasing a thunderous hiss of steam and a cloud of pheromones that turns the tidal flats into a glowing, pulsating cathedral of light and sound.

journal.en: It stores the moon's heartbeat in its bones.
The shell cracks at the shadow's edge, and the herd sings in steam.
